expanded_power_dynamic.title: Dynamic-model repair within a restricted action space
expanded_power_dynamic.caption: PowerAgentBench-Dyn DMQ case: ten independent sessions per model on one modified WECC solar PV dynamic model. Full-suite compliant success is 10/10 for Opus 4.8, 10/10 for Sonnet 4.6, and 9/10 for Haiku 4.5. Median updates are 1, 1 and 2. Eight quality tests and a maximum of five parameter updates define this case. No confidence interval or fleet-level performance is claimed.
expanded_power_dynamic.locator: Table II and section III-C, PDF p.3
expanded_power_dynamic.assumptions: Author-reported counts and medians reproduced, not independently rerun. One fixed corrupted model; no human or deterministic search comparator.
expanded_power_dynamic.credit: Original chart from cited author-reported research results

expanded_power_benchmark.title: Complete answers and partial credit measure different outcomes
expanded_power_benchmark.caption: Selected PowerBench Table 4 results. Macro Joint Accuracy equally weights the three task families, with 60 temporal, 90 contextual and 150 comparative questions; it is not a correct-count divided by 300. Overall Field Accuracy is the mean per-question fraction of correct fields. Whiskers are author-reported 95% bootstrap intervals, not newly calculated intervals. All three configurations used the same 300-question benchmark and 50-call/300-second retrieval-and-reasoning budgets.
expanded_power_benchmark.locator: Table 4, PDF p.8; aggregation definitions section 4.1 and Appendix D
expanded_power_benchmark.assumptions: Different aggregation rules are retained. Partial field credit is not full-task success. Do not infer pairwise significance from marginal interval overlap. Benchmark results are synthetic and author-reported; public runnable release not verified.
expanded_power_benchmark.credit: Original chart from cited author-reported scores and bootstrap intervals

expanded_power_gridmind.title: Artifact reuse saves executions and wall time
expanded_power_gridmind.caption: GridMind weather-risk workflow, same seven-query session on a synthetic Texas 2000-bus case. Full-rerun ablation executes 35 stages and takes 1432.6 s; content-addressed reuse executes 14 stages and takes 677.1 s. The stage-count reduction is 60%; the calculated wall-time speedup is 2.1158× (2.12× rounded), corresponding to 52.7363% less wall time. These are different metrics, not two descriptions of the same percentage. No repeated-session uncertainty estimate is reported.
expanded_power_gridmind.assumptions: Same reported query sequence; full-rerun arm uses fresh namespaces. Single simulation session, surrogate screening and reduced-order cascade models. No live utility operation or independently repeated performance claim.
expanded_power_gridmind.credit: Original chart from cited author-reported session/ablation measurements
